info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Benefits Management API
info.description: The Employee Benefits Management API facilitates the modification of employee benefits information within a human resource management system. This API enables companies to update various aspects of employee benefits tailored to individual needs. Typical consumers include HR administrators and managers who need to ensure that employee benefits are accurately maintained and compliant with organizational policies. This API streamlines the management of employee perks, making it easier to adapt to changing requirements.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the employee benefits for a specified employee. You can modify various aspects of the benefits package associated with the employee identified by their unique ID.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the necessary details to update the employee benefits for the specified employee ID. It should include any fields that need to be modified as part of the employee's benefits package.

200.description: Request completed successfully, updated employee benefits are returned.
